name: Database Client
tagline: Connect to databases and run SQL

offers.label: Ensure session
offers.description: This person's window, made by their own first action so it is theirs to read and write.

offers.label: Disconnect
offers.description: Closes the open connection on this device.

offers.label: Add connection
offers.description: Adds a connection to the workspace, keeps its password on this device, and opens it.

offers.label: Save query
offers.description: Saves the statement in the editor under `name`.

offers.label: Load starter
offers.description: Puts a starter query in the editor, saved so the person can name it too.

offers.label: Choose tab
offers.description: Shows the view the segment at `index` names.

offers.label: Begin transaction
offers.description: Starts a transaction on the open connection: what runs until the person commits is one

offers.label: Commit transaction
offers.description: Commits the open transaction: what it changed is the database's from now on.

offers.label: Roll back transaction
offers.description: Rolls the open transaction back: every change it made is taken back.

offers.label: Run
offers.description: Runs the statement in the editor, asking first when it changes data.

offers.label: Confirm run
offers.description: Runs the statement the person confirmed.

offers.label: Dismiss run
offers.description: Puts away the statement that was waiting for confirmation.

offers.label: Start statement
offers.description: Starts `sql` on the open connection as a job, so the window stays live and the statement can

offers.label: Cancel
offers.description: Stops the statement in flight.

offers.label: Load structure
offers.description: Reads the selected table's keys and indexes; its columns came with the catalog.

offers.label: Load page
offers.description: Loads one page of the selected table's rows.

offers.label: Next page
offers.description: Shows the next page of the selected table's rows.

offers.label: Previous page
offers.description: Shows the page before the one shown.

offers.label: Refresh catalog
offers.description: Reads the open connection's catalog again, so a table made elsewhere shows.

offers.label: Order by
offers.description: Orders the result by the column the person chose, or back to the statement's own order.

offers.label: Copy result
offers.description: Copies the whole result as tab-separated text.

offers.label: Export as CSV
offers.description: The statement's result as a CSV file, for a person to keep.

offers.label: Dismiss
offers.description: Clears what the window last said.

offers.label: Opened
offers.description: Takes a connection's handle in, once the engine opened it, and reads its catalog.

offers.label: Queried
offers.description: Takes a statement's result in, with the words the window shows of it.
